reply.text:
I need to look up what you've been training to give you the best answer here. ACL is a conversation for a doctor or physio first — they need to clear what's safe and what's not. That's not something I can work around without knowing the specifics of the injury and where you're at in recovery.

Once you've got clearance on what movements to avoid and what you can do, I can build a program around that. Tell me what they say to stay away from and what's OK, and we'll work with what you've got.
